problem: After multiple structural website browser fixes, a fresh exact-current candidate run is required before treating the current website as verified.
root_cause: Earlier browser evidence belonged to superseded candidate SHAs and cannot prove the current main state.
decision: Re-run the canonical cross-browser screenshot assurance on an exact Netlify preview derived from current main and repair any remaining failures in the same lineage.
prevention: Never reuse browser evidence from a superseded candidate.
Use exact preview for PR validation and production for scheduled validation.
